scientific_integrity: The proof reconstructs the tree-cut transport lemma, exact normalization, scale envelope and threshold. A finite LP checker supplies corroboration only, not an infinite proof. No external independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite ultrametric spaces; real zero-total-mass signed measures; dual sum-type bounded-Lipschitz norm only. No infinite-space, complex-valued, or nonzero-total-mass result is asserted. The underlying tree transport identity is acknowledged as classical; possible historical priority overlap under bounded transport terminology remains open.
title: Exact hierarchical Dudley norms and sharp scale selection on finite ultrametrics
